description: This file manages plugin capability contracts, including loading, caching, and resolving plugin and provider information for various capabilities such as web fetch, web search, speech, media understanding, image and video generation, and real-time transcription and voice. It also handles error reporting related to plugin registry loading.

methods.name: createProviderContractPluginIdsByProviderId
methods.description: Creates a map from provider IDs to associated plugin IDs based on plugin contract snapshots.

methods.name: uniqueStrings
methods.description: Removes duplicate strings from an array, preserving order.

methods.name: loadProviderContractEntriesForPluginIds
methods.description: Loads provider contract entries for multiple plugin IDs.

methods.name: loadProviderContractEntriesForPluginId
methods.description: Loads provider contract entries for a specific plugin ID, with caching and error handling.

methods.name: loadProviderContractRegistry
methods.description: Loads all provider contract entries, with caching and error handling.

methods.name: loadUniqueProviderContractProviders
methods.description: Returns unique provider plugins from the loaded provider contract registry.

methods.name: loadProviderContractPluginIds
methods.description: Returns all plugin IDs from the bundled provider plugin IDs.

methods.name: loadProviderContractCompatPluginIds
methods.description: Returns plugin IDs for compatibility, same as loadProviderContractPluginIds.

methods.name: resolveWebSearchCredentialValue
methods.description: Resolves credential value for WebSearchProviderPlugin based on environment variables and plugin properties.

methods.name: resolveWebFetchCredentialValue
methods.description: Resolves credential value for WebFetchProviderPlugin based on environment variables and plugin properties.

methods.name: loadWebFetchProviderContractRegistry
methods.description: Loads web fetch provider contract entries with credential values, with caching.

methods.name: resolveWebFetchProviderContractEntriesForPluginId
methods.description: Retrieves web fetch provider contract entries for a specific plugin ID, with caching.

methods.name: loadWebSearchProviderContractRegistry
methods.description: Loads web search provider contract entries with credential values, with caching.

methods.name: resolveWebSearchProviderContractEntriesForPluginId
methods.description: Retrieves web search provider contract entries for a specific plugin ID, with caching.

methods.name: loadSpeechProviderContractRegistry
methods.description: Loads speech provider contract entries, using Vitest registry in test environment.

methods.name: loadRealtimeVoiceProviderContractRegistry
methods.description: Loads realtime voice provider contract entries, using Vitest registry in test environment.

methods.name: loadRealtimeTranscriptionProviderContractRegistry
methods.description: Loads realtime transcription provider contract entries, using Vitest registry in test environment.

methods.name: loadMediaUnderstandingProviderContractRegistry
methods.description: Loads media understanding provider contract entries, using Vitest registry in test environment.

methods.name: loadImageGenerationProviderContractRegistry
methods.description: Loads image generation provider contract entries, using Vitest registry in test environment.

methods.name: loadVideoGenerationProviderContractRegistry
methods.description: Loads video generation provider contract entries, using Vitest registry in test environment.

methods.name: createLazyArrayView
methods.description: Creates a proxy-based lazy loader for arrays, deferring load until accessed.

methods.name: loadPluginRegistrationContractRegistry
methods.description: Loads plugin registration data from bundled snapshots, ensuring unique string lists.
